Blur.decision: Smart contract vesting contracts mulai release bulanan ke team/investor
Blur.immediate_result: Sell pressure tambahan ~bulanan; circulating supply meningkat
Blur.long_term_impact: Fully diluted valuation pressure hingga 2027-2028; alignment team/investor jangka panjang
Blur.supporting_dataset: Phase 6 Vesting Schedule, Major Token Events; Phase 5 Financial Risk

Blur.title: Blur Mobile App Beta launch
Blur.trigger: Ekspansi user base ke-delà power trader desktop; mobile-first retail adoption
Blur.evidence: Mobile app beta iOS/Android Juni 2024 (EV-014; Phase 4 Core Components Mobile App)
Blur.decision: Build native mobile app dengan feature parity desktop
Blur.immediate_result: Beta testing komunitas; belum feature-complete atau audit mobile khusus
Blur.long_term_impact: Potential retail user growth; security surface expansion; resource allocation ke mobile vs core protocol
Blur.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-014; Phase 4 Core Components, Known Technical Limitations; Phase 7 Applications Evolution Pattern Strategi Produk: Dari Marketplace Murni → Marketplace + Lending Protocol (Blend) · Phase 2022: Fokus singular pada Blur Marketplace (aggregator, bidding, zero fee) untuk ramp volume dan ambil share dari OpenSea (EV-002) · Phase 2023 Q2: Ekspansi ke Blend (NFT lending) sebagai produk kedua terintegrasi, membuka TAM NFTfi dan revenue stream baru (EV-010) · Phase 2024: Fee switch activation menambah value accrual ke token; mobile app menambah distribution channel · Driver: Satu-satunya cara defend market share di bear market NFT adalah memperluas revenue per user (lending yield + fee switch) dan user base (mobile) Teknologi: Off-chain Orderbook Tetap Terpusat; Smart Contract Upgrade via Proxy · Awal 2022: Arsitektur off-chain orderbook + on-chain settlement dipilih untuk speed dan UX (gas efficient, trait bids, collection bids) · 2023-2024: Kontrak marketplace dan Blend menggunakan TransparentUpgradeableProxy/UUPS (Phase 4 Security Model) — upgrade oleh multisig tanpa timelock DAO · Tidak ada pergerakan ke on-chain orderbook (Seaport-style) atau L2 deployment — komitmen Ethereum L1 settlement tetap · Driver: Technical debt terkelola via proxy upgrades; centralization trade-off diterima untuk UX pro-trader Tokenomics: Dari Airdrop Heavy → Fee Switch Real Yield · TGE Feb 2023: 12% supply airdrop immediate, 51% community allocation untuk seasonal incentives (Season 1-3) — inflationary pressure via emissions · Feb 2024: Fee switch aktif, 0.5% protocol fee ke staker — pivot ke value accrual model, mengurangi ketergantungan pada token emissions untuk retention · Team/Investor unlock mulai Feb 2024 (1-year cliff) — supply-side pressure berlawanan dengan demand-side fee switch · Driver: Maturity protokol; butuh narrative "real yield" untuk justify holding BLUR pasca-incentive seasons Governance: Dari Multisig-Centric → DAO-Signaled tapi Multisig-Executed · 2022-2023: Blur Labs multisig kontrol penuh (admin, fee, pause, upgrade) · TGE Feb 2023: DAO formed, Snapshot voting, proposal flow — tapi execution masih multisig Blur Labs · 2024: Fee switch proposal passed DAO, executed multisig — pattern: DAO signals, multisig executes · Belum ada timelock contract atau full DAO ownership transfer per 2024-10 (Phase 4 Security Model, Phase 2 Entity Blur Multisig) · Driver: Legal/regulatory caution (securities law); technical complexity timelock; founder control retention Pendanaan: VC-Backed → Protocol Revenue + DAO Treasury · 2022: Series A $11M Paradigm @ $1B valuation — fully VC-funded ops · 2023: TGE menciptakan DAO treasury (51% supply) + protocol revenue potential (fee switch, Blend fees) · 2024: Fee switch live, Blend revenue ongoing — transisi ke protocol-owned revenue, tapi treasury composition tidak transparan (Phase 5 Treasury) · Driver: Runway VC terbatas; perlu sustainable revenue untuk independence dari investor Technical Decision Pattern Pola 1: Ethereum L1 Settlement Only — No L2, No Multi-chain · Decision Pattern: Semua kontrak (Marketplace, Blend, BLUR Token) dideploy hanya di Ethereum mainnet; tidak ada deployment Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Blast, atau chain lain per 2024-10

Aptos.title: Pendirian Aptos Labs Inc. oleh Mo Shaikh (CEO) dan Avery Ching (CTO) mantan lead engineer Diem
Aptos.trigger: Meta menutup proyek Diem/Libra Januari 2022; founder ingin melanjutkan teknologi Move sebagai L1 independen
Aptos.evidence: Founder background ex-Diem; Aptos Labs incorporated Delaware Desember 2021 (HIGH) [Aptos Labs Team, https://aptoslabs.com/team]
Aptos.decision: Membangun perusahaan for-profit untuk develop core protocol, Move VM, tooling, dan produk komersial (Petra Wallet)
Aptos.immediate_result: Entity terstruktur untuk fundraising dan hiring; pre-Series A development dimulai
Aptos.long_term_impact: Menjadi backbone engineering seluruh ekosistem Aptos; memisahkan komersial (Labs) dari protokol (Foundation)
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 1 Founders; Phase 2 Entity Apt Labs Inc., Mo Shaikh, Avery Ching; Phase 3 EV-003

Aptos.title: Launch Aptos Incentivized Testnet Wave 1 (AIT-1)
Aptos.trigger: Perlu stress-test parallel execution (Block-STM), consensus (AptosBFT), staking mechanics sebelum mainnet
Aptos.evidence: Ribuan validator dan developer partisipasi; airdrop allocation untuk community (HIGH) [Aptos Blog AIT-1, https://medium.com/aptoslabs/aptos-incentivized-testnet-1-is-live-9f3b5e5c5f5e]
Aptos.decision: Incentivized testnet dengan reward token (airdrop nanti) untuk bootstrap validator set dan developer feedback
Aptos.immediate_result: Validator set tested at scale; bug ditemukan dan diperbaiki; community building dimulai awal
Aptos.long_term_impact: Airdrop recipients menjadi early community; testnet data inform mainnet parameter; model diulang untuk AIT-2/3
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-004; Phase 6 Distribution Community Airdrop

Aptos.title: Series A Funding $200M led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) pada valuasi $2B
Aptos.trigger: Perlu capital besar untuk scaling team (~100+ engineers), testnet incentivized, persiapan mainnet
Aptos.evidence: Largest Series A for L1 at the time; investor lineup includes Multicoin, Binance Labs, Coinbase Ventures, Tiger Global (HIGH) [TechCrunch, https://techcrunch.com/2022/03/29/aptos-labs-raises-200m-at-2b-valuation-led-by-a16z/]
Aptos.decision: Equity funding ke Aptos Labs Inc. + SAFT token allocation untuk investor (13.48% supply)
Aptos.immediate_result: Runway untuk mainnet launch; strategic investors memberikan exchange listing support, market making, ecosystem access
Aptos.long_term_impact: Investor vesting cliff 1 tahun + 4 tahun linear unlock menciptakan sell pressure jangka menengah (mulai Okt 2023); board seat a16z mempengaruhi strategic direction Labs
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-005; Phase 5 Funding History; Phase 6 Distribution Investors, Vesting Schedule

Aptos.title: Pendirian Aptos Foundation di Cayman Islands sebagai non-profit terpisah
Aptos.trigger: Perlu legal wrapper untuk treasury protokol, grant distribution, governance facilitation, validator set decentralization — terpisah dari for-profit Labs
Aptos.evidence: Foundation manages 16.5% supply + portion of Community 51.02%; Cayman Islands jurisdiction untuk non-profit (HIGH) [Aptos Foundation Governance, https://aptosfoundation.org/governance]
Aptos.decision: Foundation holds protocol treasury; runs Grants DAO; oversees validator decentralization; Labs focuses on core dev & commercial products
Aptos.immediate_result: Governance structure established; grant programs launched; validator onboarding formalized
Aptos.long_term_impact: Dual-entity structure (Labs + Foundation) menciptakan tension: Labs commercial interests vs Foundation protocol neutrality; transparency dashboard belum ada
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-009; Phase 2 Entity Aptos Foundation; Phase 5 Treasury; Phase 7 Governance Ecosystem

Aptos.title: Mainnet Genesis & TGE 1B APT
Aptos.trigger: Testnet complete; funding secured; validator set ready; exchange commitments (Binance, Coinbase, FTX)
Aptos.evidence: 1B APT minted genesis; allocation per whitepaper: Community 51.02%, Core Contributors 19%, Foundation 16.5%, Investors 13.48% (HIGH) [Aptos Blog Mainnet, https://medium.com/aptoslabs/aptos-mainnet-is-live-9f3b5e5c5f5e]
Aptos.decision: Full supply minted at genesis; hanya kategori tanpa vesting (airdrop, Foundation ops) liquid immediately; Contributors & Investors locked 1 year
Aptos.immediate_result: Network live; trading begins on major CEX same week; airdrop claimed; staking activated
Aptos.long_term_impact: Tokenomics inflationary (staking reward) + deflationary (base fee burn) dynamic; vesting unlocks mulai Okt 2023 menciptakan structural sell pressure 2+ tahun
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-007, EV-008; Phase 6 TGE, Distribution, Vesting Schedule, Inflation/Deflation

Aptos.title: Launch Petra Wallet sebagai official wallet
Aptos.trigger: Perlu native wallet untuk user onboarding, dApp connector standard, NFT display, Keyless integration
Aptos.evidence: Built by Aptos Labs; browser extension + mobile; Ledger support; Keyless native (EV-010) (HIGH) [Petra Wallet, https://petra.app]
Aptos.decision: First-party wallet development oleh Labs (bukan third-party grant); auto-update via app stores
Aptos.immediate_result: Default wallet untuk Aptos users; dApp connector standard (wallet adapter); Keyless distribution channel
Aptos.long_term_impact: Labs controls primary user interface; competing wallets (Martian, Fewcha, Nightly) emerge but Petra has first-mover advantage; Labs commercial interest vs ecosystem neutrality
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-010; Phase 4 Core Components Petra Wallet; Phase 7 Wallet Ecosystem

Aptos.title: Integrasi Wormhole Bridge untuk wrapped APT cross-chain
Aptos.trigger: Perlu cross-chain liquidity untuk DeFi participation; no native cross-chain messaging at protocol layer
Aptos.evidence: Wormhole enables wrapped APT on Ethereum, Solana, BSC, Polygon (EV-013) (HIGH) [Wormhole Portal, https://wormhole.com/token-bridge]
Aptos.decision: External bridge dependency sebagai primary cross-chain solution; LayerZero added later untuk OFT standard
Aptos.immediate_result: APT accessible di Ethereum DeFi (Uniswap, Curve); bridge volume significant
Aptos.long_term_impact: Bridge risk (Wormhole hack history) becomes systemic risk untuk wrapped APT holders; no protocol-level control over bridge security
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-013; Phase 4 Cross-chain Messaging; Phase 7 External Dependencies Wormhole, Major Integrations Wormhole

Aptos.title: Google Cloud & AWS sebagai official validator infrastructure partners
Aptos.trigger: Validator hardware requirements tinggi (32 cores, 64GB RAM, 2TB NVMe); perlu enterprise-grade hosting untuk geographic decentralization
Aptos.evidence: Both cloud providers announce managed validator services, marketplace AMI, KMS integration (EV-014) (HIGH) [Google Cloud Web3 Aptos, https://cloud.google.com/web3/aptos]
Aptos.decision: Formal partnership dengan major cloud providers untuk lower barrier validator operations
Aptos.immediate_result: Easy deployment untuk institutional validators; validator count grows to 100+
Aptos.long_term_impact: Centralization risk: signifikan % validator hosted on Google Cloud/AWS; single cloud outage could affect quorum; no slashing amplifies risk
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-014; Phase 7 Infrastructure Providers, Major Integrations, Ecosystem Risks Cloud Centralization

Aptos.title: Aptos Names Service (ANS) launch mainnet
Aptos.trigger: Human-readable addresses needed untuk UX; ENS equivalent untuk Aptos
Aptos.evidence: .apt domains live; integrated wallets, explorer, dApps (EV-017) (HIGH) [ANS Official, https://aptosnames.com]
Aptos.decision: On-chain naming registry dengan renewal fee APT; Foundation/Labs supported development
Aptos.immediate_result: .apt adoption massal; primary identity primitive ekosistem
Aptos.long_term_impact: Revenue stream (renewal fees) ke ANS treasury; potential governance vector (name-based voting); squatting risk
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-017; Phase 4 Core Components ANS Contracts; Phase 7 Applications ANS

Aptos.title: Keyless Authentication launch (OIDC + ZKP) mainnet
Aptos.trigger: Seed phrase barrier mencegah mass adoption; perlu passwordless onboarding via Google/Apple OAuth
Aptos.evidence: ZKP (Groth16) verifies OIDC JWT claims on-chain; live mainnet 2023; v1.8 upgrade enhanced (EV-018, EV-029) (HIGH) [Aptos Keyless Paper, https://aptos.dev/whitepaper/aptos-keyless.pdf]
Aptos.decision: Native account abstraction at protocol layer (bukan smart contract wallet seperti ERC-4337); ZKP circuit untuk privacy
Aptos.immediate_result: Users create accounts via Google/Apple login; gas paid by sponsor or user; no seed phrase management
Aptos.long_term_impact: Differentiator vs EVM chains; but adoption metrics not public; ZKP circuit audit dependency; OIDC provider centralization (Google/Apple)
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-018, EV-029; Phase 4 Core Components Keyless Module, Security Model; Phase 7 Applications Keyless

Aptos.title: Protocol Upgrade v1.5 (Performance, Gas Schedule, Validator Ops)
Aptos.trigger: Mainnet performance optimization needed; gas schedule v1 static; validator rotation improvements needed
Aptos.evidence: Block-STM optimization; dynamic gas schedule; reduced block time variance (EV-027) (HIGH) [Aptos Core Releases v1.5, https://github.com/aptos-labs/aptos-core/releases/tag/aptos-v1.5.0]
Aptos.decision: On-chain governance proposal untuk upgrade; validator set coordination required
Aptos.immediate_result: Throughput increase; gas cost stabilization; validator operations efficiency
Aptos.long_term_impact: Demonstrates governance upgrade capability; sets precedent untuk future upgrades (v1.8 Move 2024 Edition)
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-027; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History v1.5; Phase 6 Governance Proposal System

Aptos.title: NodeReal & Nodit sebagai official enterprise RPC/Indexer partners
Aptos.trigger: Public RPC unreliable untuk production dApps; perlu enterprise-grade indexing, GraphQL, gRPC
Aptos.evidence: NodeReal & Nodit provide production RPC, indexer gRPC v2, GraphQL API (EV-028) (HIGH) [NodeReal Aptos, https://nodereal.io/aptos]
Aptos.decision: Formal partnership dan endorsement untuk enterprise infrastructure providers
Aptos.immediate_result: Reliable RPC for developers; indexer v2 adoption accelerated
Aptos.long_term_impact: Concentration risk: 2 providers dominate production traffic; no SLA transparency; dApps dependent on their uptime
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-028; Phase 7 Infrastructure Providers, Major Integrations, Ecosystem Risks Indexer Concentration Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari "Diem continuation" ke "Independent Move L1 dengan differentiation teknis" · Early Phase (2021-2022): Narrative fokus pada "spiritual successor Diem", Move language heritage, ex-Meta team credibility · Growth Phase (2023-2024): Pivot ke technical differentiation sendiri — Block-STM parallel execution, Keyless account abstraction, Move 2024 Edition, institutional infrastructure partnerships

Aptos.title: Protocol Upgrade v1.8 (Move 2024 Edition, Account Abstraction Enhancements, Keyless v2)
Aptos.trigger: Move language evolution; developer experience improvement; account abstraction maturity
Aptos.evidence: Generics, enums, pattern matching; Keyless v2; gas schedule v3; multi-signer improvements (EV-029) (HIGH) [Aptos Core Releases v1.8, https://github.com/aptos-labs/aptos-core/releases/tag/aptos-v1.8.0]
Aptos.decision: Major language upgrade via governance; backward compatibility considerations
Aptos.immediate_result: Developer experience significantly improved; new language features available; Keyless v2 more efficient
Aptos.long_term_impact: Move 2024 Edition standardization dengan Movement Labs; ecosystem migration required untuk packages lama
Aptos.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-029; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History v1.8; Phase 7 Major Integrations Movement Labs

Irys.long_term_impact: Menjadi fondasi teknis dan organisasi untuk transisi ke Irys L1 tahun 2024

Irys.title: Integrasi Arweave sebagai permanent storage layer

Irys.long_term_impact: Fondasi adopsi developer dan feedback loop untuk testnet/mainnet

Celestia.title: Memulai penelitian LazyLedger / modular blockchain architecture
Celestia.trigger: Founders (Mustafa Al-Bassam, Ismail Khoffi, John Adler, Nick White) mengidentifikasi bottleneck execution pada monolithic blockchain; pemisahan DA dari consensus sebagai solusi skalabilitas
Celestia.evidence: Whitepaper LazyLedger diterbitkan 2021 (EV-003) berbasis penelitian 2019; blog resmi "What is Celestia" menjelaskan visi modular (Phase 1 Foundation; Phase 3 EV-001, EV-003)
Celestia.decision: Membangun protokol DA terpisah dengan DAS dan NMT, bukan general-purpose L1
Celestia.immediate_result: Konsep dasar Data Availability Sampling dan NMT terdefinisi; fondasi teknis untuk Celestia
Celestia.long_term_impact: Menjadi referensi arsitektur modular blockchain; kategori "Modular DA Layer" diciptakan

Celestia.title: Membentuk Celestia Labs Inc. di Delaware sebagai entitas for-profit core developer
Celestia.trigger: Butuh struktur hukum untuk merekrut tim engineering, menerima investasi VC, dan mengembangkan protokol secara komersial
Celestia.evidence: Incorporation Delaware 2021 (EV-002); Crunchbase menunjukkan entity Celestia Labs Inc. (Phase 3 EV-002; Phase 2 Company Celestia Labs Inc.)
Celestia.decision: Pisahkan pengembangan protokol (Labs) dari governance/treasury (Foundation yang dibentuk kemudian)
Celestia.immediate_result: Tim engineering di-rekrut; fondasi untuk Series A/B funding
Celestia.long_term_impact: Dual-entity structure (Labs + Foundation) menjadi model governance; Labs fokus execution, Foundation fokus stewardship

Celestia.title: Memublikasikan whitepaper LazyLedger di arXiv
Celestia.trigger: Butuh fondasi teknis formal untuk menarik researcher, developer, dan investor; mendefinisikan spesifikasi DAS, NMT, consensus separation
Celestia.evidence: arXiv:2105.09830 (EV-003); menjadi referensi akademis dan teknis untuk modular blockchain (Phase 3 EV-003; Phase 4)
Celestia.decision: Open research publication bukan closed development
Celestia.immediate_result: Komunitas peneliti dan developer awal terarik; validasi teknis awal
Celestia.long_term_impact: Menjadi sitasi utama untuk modular thesis; menarik investor Series A/B

Celestia.title: Rilis Rollkit framework sovereign rollup
Celestia.trigger: Butuh tooling agar developer bisa build rollup menggunakan Celestia DA tanpa menunggu mainnet; proof-of-concept modular thesis
Celestia.evidence: EV-006 Rollkit release; Golang framework, ABCI++ support, custom VM (Phase 3 EV-006; Phase 4 Rollkit; Phase 7 Developer Ecosystem)
Celestia.decision: Open source framework sebelum mainnet; sovereign rollup first, settlement layer optional
Celestia.immediate_result: Early adopter rollup bereksperimen; Sovereign SDK (Rust) muncul kemudian sebagai alternative
Celestia.long_term_impact: Rollkit menjadi primary framework untuk sovereign rollup; Manta Pacific, Dymension RollApps build di atasnya

Celestia.title: Meluncurkan Arabica Incentivized Testnet
Celestia.trigger: Butuh validasi produksi DAS, light client, consensus CometBFT dengan incentive ekonomis nyata
Celestia.evidence: EV-004 Arabica Testnet; reward untuk node operators; first live network dengan DAS (Phase 3 EV-004; Phase 7 Infrastructure Providers)
Celestia.decision: Incentivized testnet bukan testnet biasa; reward TIA allocation untuk partisipasi
Celestia.immediate_result: Jaringan node pertama beroperasi; DAS divisualisasikan di lingkungan adversarial
Celestia.long_term_impact: Model testnet incentivized diulang untuk Mocha (EV-007) dan Lemon (EV-008); validator set genesis terbentuk dari testnet performers

Celestia.title: Series A/B Funding $55M led by Bain Capital Crypto & Polychain Capital
Celestia.trigger: Butuh modal signifikan untuk scaling tim (40+ engineer), R&D QGB, BD untuk rollup integration, runway 3-5 tahun
Celestia.evidence: EV-005 $55M funding; investor: Bain Capital Crypto, Polychain, 1kx, Robot Ventures, Placeholder, Delphi Digital, Galaxy Digital, Figment Capital (Phase 3 EV-005; Phase 5 Funding History; Phase 2 Investors)

Celestia.title: Audit ganda Informal Systems + Trail of Bits pre-mainnet

Celestia.evidence: EV-016 Informal Systems audit (consensus, light client, Blobstream); EV-017 Trail of Bits audit (Celestia App, Blobstream contracts, crypto primitives) (Phase 3 EV-016, EV-017; Phase 4 Audit History)

Celestia.immediate_result: Critical findings fixed pre-launch; security credibility untuk rollup integration
Celestia.long_term_impact: Ongoing audit relationship (Zellic 2024, Sigma Prime 2024); security-first culture

Celestia.title: Meluncurkan Mocha Incentivized Testnet dengan Blobstream integration
Celestia.trigger: Butuh test Blobstream bridge ke Ethereum mainnet sebelum mainnet; validasi relayer network dan cross-chain verification
Celestia.evidence: EV-007 Mocha Testnet; Blobstream relayer testing; Ethereum testnet integration (Phase 3 EV-007; Phase 4 Blobstream; Phase 7 Major Integrations)

Celestia.long_term_impact: Blobstream mainnet deploy (EV-012) lancar; Arbitrum Orbit/Starknet/Polygon CDK integration siap saat mainnet

Celestia.title: Membentuk Celestia Foundation di Zug, Switzerland
Celestia.trigger: Mainnet launch membutuhkan entitas non-profit untuk treasury management, governance stewardship, grants, compliance regulatory
Celestia.evidence: EV-011 Foundation formation; Zug jurisdiction dipilih untuk crypto-friendly foundation law; separate dari Labs (Delaware for-profit) (Phase 3 EV-011; Phase 2 Foundation; Phase 5 Treasury)
Celestia.decision: Dual entity structure: Labs (core dev, for-profit) + Foundation (treasury, governance, grants, non-profit)

Celestia.title: Deploy Blobstream contracts ke Ethereum Mainnet
Celestia.trigger: Rollup EVM (Arbitrum Orbit, Polygon CDK) butuh trust-minimized DA verification di Ethereum settlement layer
Celestia.evidence: EV-012 Blobstream deploy; EV-013/014/015 integrasi dengan Arbitrum Orbit, Starknet, Polygon CDK announced shortly after (Phase 3 EV-012, EV-013, EV-014, EV-015; Phase 4 Blobstream; Phase 7 Major Integrations)

Celestia.immediate_result: Rollup bisa verify Celestia DA di Ethereum; first modular DA dengan Ethereum settlement live
Celestia.long_term_impact: Celestia menjadi DA layer default untuk Ethereum rollup ecosystem; Blobstream v2 upgrade planned
Celestia.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-012, EV-013, EV-014, EV-015; Phase 4; Phase 7

Celestia.title: Mainnet Launch + TGE Genesis Drop same day
Celestia.trigger: Siap produksi setelah 3 testnet; token liquidity needed untuk staking security dan governance participation
Celestia.evidence: EV-009 Mainnet launch block 0; EV-010 TGE 60M TIA (6%) Genesis Drop; immediate CEX listings (EV-024) (Phase 3 EV-009, EV-010, EV-024; Phase 6 TGE)

Celestia.title: Meluncurkan program grant Sputnik Wave 1
Celestia.trigger: Foundation treasury perlu dideploy untuk ecosystem growth; tooling, rollup, light client, infrastructure butuh funding
Celestia.evidence: EV-026 Grant program; Foundation mengelola treasury; community pool spend via governance (Phase 3 EV-026; Phase 2 Foundation; Phase 5 Financial Dependencies; Phase 7 Ecosystem)
Celestia.decision: Milestone-based grants; open application; focus pada tooling, rollup frameworks, light client adoption
Celestia.immediate_result: Builder onboarding accelerated; ecosystem projects funded (explorers, indexers, wallets, rollup templates)
Celestia.long_term_impact: Sustainable ecosystem growth loop; grant recipients menjadi contributors

Celestia.title: Upgrade protokol v2.0 via governance
Celestia.trigger: Perlu fee market tuning, DAS parameter optimization, namespace versioning untuk rollup scaling
Celestia.evidence: EV-021 Upgrade v2.0; on-chain proposal passed; validator coordination via Cosmovisor (Phase 3 EV-021; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History; Phase 6 Governance)
Celestia.decision: Governance-driven upgrade process; backward compatibility maintained; parameter changes via proposal
Celestia.immediate_result: Blobspace throughput improved; fee market more responsive; namespace v2 support
Celestia.long_term_impact: Precedent untuk upgrade v3.0 "Ginger" (EV-029); governance maturity demonstrated

Celestia.title: Diskusi Fee Switch / Value Accrual di governance
Celestia.trigger: Token holders meminta value capture mechanism; base fee burn saja tidak cukup untuk TIA accrual narrative
Celestia.evidence: EV-027 Fee Switch discussion; forum governance active debate; belum ada proposal formal passed (Phase 3 EV-027; Phase 6 Inflation/Deflation; Phase 8 Narrative)
Celestia.decision: Community-led discussion dulu, formal proposal kemudian; transparency over speed
Celestia.immediate_result: Narrative management; investor expectation setting; technical design untuk fee distribution ke staker
Celestia.long_term_impact: Jika passed, mengubah TIA dari pure gas/governance token ke value accrual asset; mempengaruhi staking yield dan valuation

Celestia.title: Rilis Light Client WASM + Mobile SDK
Celestia.trigger: Butuh trust-minimized verification di browser dan mobile untuk end-user adoption; rollup light client integration
Celestia.evidence: EV-028 Light Client WASM release; wasm-bindgen compilation; browser extension dan mobile wallet integration (Phase 3 EV-028; Phase 4 Current Stack WASM; Phase 7 Integrations)
Celestia.decision: Rust light client compiled to WASM; npm package distribution; mobile SDK (iOS/Android)
Celestia.immediate_result: Verifikasi DA dari frontend dApp menjadi possible; user tidak perlu trust RPC provider
Celestia.long_term_impact: Differentiator vs EigenDA/Avail (light client accessibility); sovereign rollup user experience improvement

Celestia.title: Upgrade protokol v3.0 "Ginger"
Celestia.trigger: DAS throughput bottleneck; namespace versioning untuk multi-rollup; QGB integration preparation
Celestia.evidence: EV-029 Upgrade v3.0; governance proposal; namespace versioning, DAS throughput increase, QGB prep (Phase 3 EV-029; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History; Phase 4 Known Limitations)
Celestia.decision: Major upgrade via governance; breaking changes untuk namespace versioning; validator coordination critical
Celestia.immediate_result: Higher blobspace capacity; namespace v2/v3 support; foundation untuk QGB
Celestia.long_term_impact: Scaling headroom untuk 2025+ rollup demand; QGB testnet readiness (EV-030)

Celestia.title: Quantum Gravity Bridge Testnet publik
Celestia.trigger: R&D selesai desain; butuh adversarial testing untuk trust-minimized bridging tanpa validator set
Celestia.evidence: EV-030 QGB Testnet; Phase 3 EV-020 research; Forum discussion (Phase 3 EV-020, EV-030; Phase 4 QGB; Phase 7 Integrations)
Celestia.decision: Public testnet dengan bug bounty; light client verification circuits testing; cross-chain message passing
Celestia.immediate_result: Security validation; relayer/operator feedback; bridge design iteration
Celestia.long_term_impact: Jika berhasil, Celestia punya native bridging tanpa trusted relayer; unik vs EigenDA/Avail
Celestia.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-020, EV-030; Phase 4; Phase 7 Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari Research Project → Production DA Layer → Modular Ecosystem Hub · Fase 1 (2019-2021): Pure research — LazyLedger whitepaper, arsitektur teoretis, tidak ada code production (Phase 3 EV-001, EV-003) · Fase 2 (2021-2022): Company formation + testnet iteration — Celestia Labs Inc., Series A/B, Arabica/Mocha testnet, Rollkit release (Phase 3 EV-002, EV-004, EV-005, EV-006, EV-007) · Fase 3 (2023): Production launch + ecosystem onboarding — Mainnet, TGE, Foundation, Blobstream, major rollup integrations (Arbitrum, Starknet, Polygon CDK) (Phase 3 EV-009, EV-010, EV-011, EV-012, EV-013, EV-014, EV-015) · Fase 4 (2024-2025): Scaling + value accrual + next-gen bridging — Upgrade v2.0/v3.0, grant program, fee switch discussion, QGB testnet, light client WASM (Phase 3 EV-021, EV-026, EV-027, EV-028, EV-029, EV-030)

Cardano.title: Pendirian Input Output Hong Kong (IOHK/IOG) dan dimulainya penelitian Cardano
Cardano.trigger: Charles Hoskinson dan Jeremy Wood keluar dari Ethereum; ingin membangun platform blockchain generasi ketiga berbasis penelitian akademis dan formal verification
Cardano.evidence: IOG didirikan 2015 di Hong Kong; program penelitian Ouroboros PoS dimulai sebelum ada kode produksi
Cardano.decision: Membentuk entitas R&D terpisah (IOG) yang fokus pada penelitian protokol, bukan produk konsumen
Cardano.immediate_result: Entitas pengembang inti terbentuk; penelitian Ouroboros Classic dimulai
Cardano.long_term_impact: Menetapkan DNA "research-first" yang membedakan Cardano dari proyek lain; semua upgrade protokol didahului paper akademis dan formal proofs
Cardano.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 History (EV-001), Phase 2 Entity (IOG, Charles Hoskinson, Jeremy Wood), Phase 4 Technology (Ouroboros Consensus Protocol Family)

Cardano.title: Penjualan voucher ADA (ICO) melalui entitas Swiss Attain Alternative Strategies Ltd
Cardano.trigger: Butuh dana ~$62M untuk pengembangan 2+ tahun sebelum mainnet launch; menghindari regulasi token sale yang belum jelas 2015
Cardano.evidence: Voucher sale model (bukan token sale langsung) di bawah hukum Swiss; ~25.9B ADA terjual ke pasar Asia (utamanya Jepang); dana dikumpulkan dalam BTC dan JPY
Cardano.decision: Menggunakan voucher sale model hukum Swiss dengan entity terpisah (Attain) untuk kompliance; tidak ada private sale/VC round
Cardano.immediate_result: ~$62M terkumpul; distribusi token awal tertata; community retail-dominant dari awal (Jepang)
Cardano.long_term_impact: Tidak ada investor VC dengan token unlock schedule yang menciptakan sell pressure; distribusi lebih merata ke retail; tapi tidak ada "smart money" strategic partners awal
Cardano.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 History (EV-002), Phase 5 Financial (Funding History, Token Sale), Phase 6 Token (Distribution, TGE)

Cardano.title: Pendirian Cardano Foundation di Zug, Swiss sebagai yayasan nirlaba
Cardano.trigger: Butuh entitas hukum terpisah untuk hold merek, standarisasi, governance, dan treasury yang netral dari pengembang teknis (IOG)
Cardano.evidence: Foundation didirikan 2016 di Zug (Crypto Valley); menerima genesis allocation 648M ADA (1.4% initial supply)
Cardano.decision: Struktur tri-entitas: IOG (R&D), Foundation (governance/standards), Emurgo (commercial adoption) — masing-masing dengan genesis allocation terpisah
Cardano.immediate_result: Governance layer terpisah dari development layer; merek Cardano dijaga oleh yayasan Swiss
Cardano.long_term_impact: Memungkinkan transisi ke CIP-1694 on-chain governance di mana Foundation menjadi salah satu stakeholder, bukan penguasa tunggal; struktur netral memudahkan adopsi enterprise/pemerintah
Cardano.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 History (EV-003), Phase 2 Entity (Cardano Foundation), Phase 5 Financial (Funding History - Genesis Allocation)

Cardano.title: Peluncuran mainnet dengan federated consensus (Ouroboros BFT / Era Byron) bukan fully decentralized PoS
Cardano.trigger: Protokol PoS terdesentralisasi (Praos) belum siap produksi; butuh mainnet live untuk token transfer, wallet, dan ekosistem awal
Cardano.evidence: Byron era menggunakan federated block production oleh IOG/Foundation/Emurgo nodes; Daedalus full-node wallet; ADA transferable; staking delegation ada tapi reward belum aktif
Cardano.decision: Launch mainnet dengan "training wheels" (federated consensus) dulu, upgrade ke decentralized PoS via hard fork combinator nanti
Cardano.immediate_result: Mainnet live 2017; ADA listed Bittrex 2017-11; ekosistem wallet (Daedalus) beroperasi
Cardano.long_term_impact: Membuktikan Hard Fork Combinator works (Byron→Shelley transisi seamless 2020); menghindari "launch delay" seperti banyak proyek PoS lain; tapi kritikus menuding "centralized launch"
Cardano.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 History (EV-007, EV-011), Phase 4 Technology (Hard Fork Combinator, Consensus Mechanism, Technical Upgrade History)

Cardano.title: Hard fork Shelley — transisi ke Ouroboros Praos decentralized PoS dengan stake pool operators komunitas
Cardano.trigger: Penelitian Ouroboros Praos selesai; formal proofs published; testnet berjalan stabil; komunitas siap jalankan SPO
Cardano.evidence: ~1000+ SPO aktif minggu pertama; insentif staking on-chain dimulai (reward dari fee + monetary expansion); Hard Fork Combinator debut production
Cardano.decision: Hard fork non-contentious via Hard Fork Combinator; tidak ada chain split; reward sharing mechanism live
Cardano.immediate_result: Jaringan fully decentralized block production; staking participation rate naik cepat (>70% supply staked historis)
Cardano.long_term_impact: Menetapkan Cardano sebagai PoS terbesar dengan formal verification; model delegasi liquid (tidak ada slashing, tidak ada lock-up) jadi differentiator; fondasi untuk governance nanti (stake = voting power)
Cardano.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 History (EV-011), Phase 4 Technology (Consensus Mechanism, Technical Upgrade History), Phase 6 Token (Utility - Staking, Inflation)

Cardano.title: Hard fork Mary — native multi-asset support (fungible + NFT) tanpa smart contract
Cardano.trigger: Ethereum ERC-20/ERC-721 memerlukan smart contract deployment; Cardano ingin native asset di settlement layer (CSL) untuk fee rendah dan keamanan lebih tinggi
Cardano.evidence: Mary hard fork menambahkan multi-asset ledger ke CSL; policy IDs untuk minting policies; metadata support; ribuan policy IDs dibuat minggu pertama
Cardano.decision: Implementasikan native assets di layer settlement (CSL) bukan computation layer (CCL); tidak perlu Plutus script untuk token fungible/NFT dasar
Cardano.immediate_result: Ledakan NFT Cardano (JPG Store, blue-chip collections); ribuan custom tokens tanpa smart contract risk; minimum UTxO deposit (~1-2 ADA) menciptakan structural demand ADA
Cardano.long_term_impact: eUTXO model terbukti handle native assets efisien; DeFi composability nanti (Vasil) build di atas fondasi ini; berbeda filosofis dari ERC-20 approach
Cardano.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 History (EV-013), Phase 4 Technology (Core Components - Native Asset Ledger, Execution Environment), Phase 6 Token (Utility - Native Asset Minting Fee)

Cardano.title: Hard fork Alonzo — Plutus V1 smart contracts live (Goguen era)
Cardano.trigger: Plutus Core spec complete; Plutus Application Framework ready; testnet Alonzo purple/white/blue berjalan
Cardano.evidence: eUTXO smart contract model live; datum/redeemer; cost models; script validation; Minswap/SundaeSwap mulai testnet/mainnet
Cardano.decision: Launch Plutus V1 dengan known limitations (concurrency bottleneck, fixed cost model); iterate via Vasil later
Cardano.immediate_result: Era programmable Cardano dimulai; ratusan dApp mulai development; TVL DeFi mulai tumbuh
Cardano.long_term_impact: eUTXO model terbukti bisa support complex DeFi (Indigo synthetic assets, Liqwid lending) tapi concurrency jadi bottleneck utama; Vasil hard fork (2022) diperlukan untuk fix Plutus V2 cost model dan reference inputs
Cardano.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 History (EV-014, EV-015, EV-017), Phase 4 Technology (Execution Environment, Plutus Platform, Known Technical Limitations), Phase 7 Ecosystem (Developer Ecosystem)

Cardano.title: Hard fork Vasil — pipelining, reference inputs, inline datums, Plutus V2
Cardano.trigger: Alonzo bottleneck jelas: concurrency, script size limits, diffusion speed; Vasil CIPs (31,32,33) designed untuk fix
Cardano.evidence: CIP-31 pipelined block diffusion ~2-3x throughput; CIP-32 reference inputs mengurangi UTxO lookup; CIP-33 inline datums mengurangi tx size; Plutus V2 cost model lebih efisien
Cardano.decision: Bundle multiple CIPs dalam satu hard fork besar (Vasil) bukan incremental kecil; gunakan Hard Fork Combinator untuk seamless upgrade
Cardano.immediate_result: Block propagation dipercepat; DeFi composability meningkat drastis; script fees turun; TVL peak ~$450M Maret 2024
Cardano.long_term_impact: Vasil jadi template untuk future upgrades: bundle CIPs yang saling terkait; menunjukkan eUTXO bisa scale dengan tooling yang tepat; tapi concurrency fundamental tetap ada (perlu off-chain sequencers / batching)
Cardano.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 History (EV-017), Phase 4 Technology (Technical Upgrade History, Known Technical Limitations), Phase 8 Market (Adoption Metrics - TVL peak)

Cardano.title: Midnight partner chain announcement — privacy-preserving ZK chain on Polkadot SDK
Cardano.trigger: Butuh privacy-preserving smart contracts untuk enterprise/regulatory compliance; eUTXO model tidak native support ZK; Polkadot SDK menawarkan shared security model
Cardano.evidence: Midnight: Compact language (ZK-SNARKs), DUST token consensus, Polkadot SDK base, bridge design ke Cardano mainnet; devnet v1 + public testnet 2024-10
Cardano.decision: Build partner chain terpisah (bukan L2 di Cardano mainnet) untuk privacy; gunakan Polkadot SDK bukan custom; DUST token untuk consensus (bukan ADA)
Cardano.immediate_result: Privacy-preserving smart contract execution teruji testnet; developer preview open; Midnight ekosistem developer bermula

Grass.title: Pengumuman Sovereign Data Rollup arsitektur custom (bukan SVM rollup)
Grass.trigger: Kebutuhan verifikasi data scraping terstruktur, provenance AI, dan throughput tinggi yang tidak efisien di SVM; keinginan sovereignty execution layer
Grass.evidence: Grass Blog rollup announcement Sep 25 2024, arsitektur custom sequencer/executor/prover (Grass Blog, https://blog.grass.ai/sovereign-data-rollup/); [Grass Docs, https://docs.grass.ai/architecture/rollup]
Grass.decision: Bangun rollup sovran dengan ZK-VM (RISC Zero/SP1) atau TEE (Intel TDX/AMD SEV), settle ke Solana via Verifier Program, bukan SVM-compatible
Grass.immediate_result: Roadmap teknis jangka panjang diklarifikasi, rekrutmen ZK/TEE engineers, dependency RPC tinggi (Helius/Triton)
Grass.long_term_impact: Desentralisasi Coordinator, tapi risiko eksekusi tinggi (proving cost, latency, audit complexity), delayed mainnet rollup
Grass.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-011, Phase 4 Architecture (Execution Layer, Rollup), Phase 7 External Dependencies (RISC Zero, Intel TDX) Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari "Bandwidth Sharing Network" → "AI Data Layer dengan Sovereign Rollup" · Phase Awal (2021-2023): Fokus pada membangun jaringan node bandwidth (DePIN murni), Proof of Bandwidth, sistem poin, distribusi reward. Naratif: "Monetize your unused bandwidth." (Phase 3 EV-001, EV-003, EV-004; Phase 1 Foundation) · Phase Transisi (2024 H1): Mainnet launch, mobile/lite expansion, persiapan TGE. Naratif: "Data layer for AI" mulai muncul. (Phase 3 EV-006, EV-007, EV-008) · Phase Sekarang (2024 H2+): Sovereign Data Rollup jadi centerpiece, verifikasi ZK/TEE, penjualan data enterprise, DeFi utility. Naratif: "Sovereign Data Rollup for AI." (Phase 3 EV-011, EV-014, EV-015; Phase 4 Architecture, Phase 7 Ecosystem) · Driver: Permintaan pasar AI data melonjak (LLM training), kompetisi DePIN bandwidth (Honeygain, Masa), kebutuhan diferensiasi teknis & revenue nyata. Perubahan Teknologi: Dari Coordinator Terpusat → Rollup Terdesentralisasi dengan ZK/TEE · Awal: Coordinator Wynd Labs mengelola task queue, bandwidth verification, point calculation — trusted centralized service. (Phase 4 Architecture Coordination Layer, Phase 3 EV-004) · Tengah: Smart contract token/staking/governance di Solana (SVM), tapi data flow masih off-chain via Coordinator. (Phase 3 EV-006, EV-012, EV-013; Phase 4 Smart Contracts) · Target: Sovereign Rollup dengan Sequencer/Executor/Prover, ZK proofs (RISC Zero/SP1) atau TEE attestation, Verifier on-chain Solana. Coordinator digantikan. (Phase 3 EV-011; Phase 4 Core Components Rollup, ZK Module; Phase 7 Dependencies RISC Zero/Intel TDX) · Trade-off: Kompleksitas & biaya proving vs kepercayaan minimized. Belum terbukti di skala produksi. Perubahan Tokenomics: Dari Points (Off-chain) → GRASS Token (On-chain) dengan Utility Multi-layer · Pre-TGE: Points epoch 1-7 (off-chain, centralized ledger), konversi 1:1 ke token di TGE, tidak transferable. (Phase 3 EV-004, EV-006; Phase 6 Token Distribution) · TGE: 1B supply, 24% circulating (Launchpool 3%, community/airdrop, liquidity), 76% vesting (investor 22%, team 22%, foundation/ecosystem 32%+). (Phase 6 Token Allocation, Vesting; Phase 5 Token Sale) · Post-TGE: Staking native (delegasi ke validator), DeFi utility (lend/borrow Kamino, perp Drift, CLMM Orca/Raydium), governance (future), data purchase fee (planned). (Phase 3 EV-013, EV-014; Phase 6 Utility, Staking; Phase 7 DeFi Integrations) · Evolusi: Dari reward pasif → utility aktif (staking yield, DeFi collateral, governance, data payment). Perubahan Governance: Dari Core Team Controlled → Foundation Multi-sig → On-chain DAO (Planned) · 2021-2024: Wynd Labs (Andrej, Chris) full control protokol, coordinator, treasury (pre-token). (Phase 2 Entity Wynd Labs, Phase 3 EV-001) · Sep 2024: Grass Foundation formed, multi-sig treasury (Squads), core contributors sebagai signer. Wynd Labs tetap core dev via grant/agreement. (Phase 3 EV-010; Phase 2 Entity Grass Foundation; Phase 4 Security Model Multi-sig) · Future: On-chain governance via GRASS token voting, proposal execution, parameter changes (staking rewards, fee switch, rollup upgrades). (Phase 6 Governance; Phase 7 Developer Ecosystem Grants) Perubahan Ekosistem: Dari Single-chain Solana → Multi-chain via Wormhole (Token Only) · Native: Semua aktivitas on-chain (token, staking, DeFi, NFT, rollup settlement) di Solana. (Phase 4 Architecture Settlement Layer, Phase 7 Exchange Ecosystem DEX) · Bridging: Wormhole bridge untuk GRASS ke Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon — hanya token portability, tidak consensus/rollup. (Phase 7 External Dependencies Wormhole, Phase 8 Trading Markets) · Rationale: Solana untuk throughput/fee rendah (rollup settlement), multi-chain untuk likuiditas & user acquisition. Technical Decision Pattern Pola 1: Pilih Solana sebagai Settlement Layer Eksklusif (bukan Multi-chain atau L2 Ethereum) · Decision Pattern: Semua state final (token, staking, governance, rollup verification) disetel di Solana L1; tidak deploy kontrak ekivalen di chain lain; bridging hanya untuk token portability via Wormhole

EOS.evidence: CoinDesk melaporkan ENF launch; Yves La Rose CEO ENF; proposal BP mengalihkan 1% inflasi dari eosio.saving ke eosio.ef
EOS.decision: ENF incorporated di Cayman Islands sebagai non-profit; menerima 1% annual inflation untuk protocol development, ecosystem growth, operations
EOS.immediate_result: ENF menjadi entitas pengelola resmi; tim engineering/growth/ops ~30+ orang dibangun; Spring SDK, EOS EVM, Hyperion/Firehose adoption didanai

EOS.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-015, EV-016, EV-017, EV-018; Phase 2 Entity EOS Network Foundation, Yves La Rose; Phase 5 Treasury, Revenue Model, Financial Dependencies; Phase 6 Inflation/Deflation

EOS.title: Peluncuran EOS EVM sebagai Ethereum-compatible execution layer
EOS.trigger: Dominasi Ethereum developer ecosystem; kebutuhan menarik developer Solidity tanpa rewrite ke C++; kompetisi dengan BNB Chain, Polygon, Avalanche
EOS.evidence: ENF announcement EOS EVM mainnet launch; GitHub eosnetworkfoundation/eos-evm; CertiK audit pre-launch
EOS.decision: Deploy EVM (berbasis go-ethereum/revm) sebagai smart contract native di atas WASM runtime; gas mapped ke EOS CPU/NET; precompiles untuk interoperabilitas native
EOS.immediate_result: Developer Ethereum bisa deploy dApp ke EOS dengan minimal changes; EOS EVM daily tx 5k-20k sejak launch
EOS.long_term_impact: Narasi "EVM-Compatible Layer 1" menjadi primary narrative; bridge ke Ethereum DeFi liquidity; tapi menambah kompleksitas teknis (dual runtime, gas mapping differences)
EOS.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-019; Phase 4 Execution Environment, Core Components; Phase 7 Major Integrations; Phase 8 Narrative Position

EOS.title: Spring Hard Fork / Leap 4.0 dengan RAM market reform dan Spring SDK
EOS.trigger: Keluhan biaya RAM tinggi, CDT legacy usang, butuh DX modern untuk retain/attract developers
EOS.evidence: GitHub Leap v4.0.0 release; Spring SDK release (EV-021); RAM market parameter changes di eosio.system
EOS.decision: Coordinated hard fork oleh 15/21 BP; activate Spring SDK features, revise Bancor curve params, throughput improvements
EOS.immediate_result: Spring SDK (C++20, CMake) jadi official framework; RAM pricing lebih prediktif; developer onboarding improved
EOS.long_term_impact: Technical debt CDT berkurang; tapi fragmentasi tooling (CDT legacy vs Spring SDK, EOSJS vs Anchor Link vs Wharf Kit) tetap ada
EOS.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-020, EV-021; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Development Framework, Known Technical Limitations; Phase 7 Developer Ecosystem

EOS.title: Peluncuran EOS Network Ventures (ecosystem fund) dari treasury ENF
EOS.trigger: Treasury ENF tumbuh dari inflasi 1%/tahun sejak 2021; kebutuhan strategic capital deployment ke early-stage projects
EOS.evidence: ENF announcement; blog EOS Network Foundation; Phase 5 Funding History
EOS.decision: Alokasi portion treasury ke venture fund untuk equity/token investments di DeFi, GameFi, infrastructure
EOS.immediate_result: Portfolio investments mulai terbentuk; outflow dari treasury ke external projects
EOS.long_term_impact: ENF jadi investor sekaligus protocol steward — potential conflict of interest; diversification treasury tapi exposure ke early-stage risk; no public portfolio/returns disclosure
EOS.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-024; Phase 5 Revenue Model, Financial Risk; Phase 7 Major Integrations

EOS.title: Integrasi Hyperion History API sebagai standar resmi indexing (2023-03-01) dan Firehose sebagai real-time streaming standard
EOS.trigger: Kebutuhan reliable on-chain data untuk explorer, wallet, dApp; Hyperion (EOS Rio) mature; Firehose (StreamingFast) sub-second latency
EOS.evidence: ENF adoption announcements; GitHub eosrio/hyperion; StreamingFast Firehose docs
EOS.decision: ENF merekomendasikan Hyperion untuk full-history, Firehose untuk real-time; keduanya jadi de facto standard ekosistem
EOS.immediate_result: Infrastructure layer terstandarisasi; pengembang punya clear choice; BP/operator deploy keduanya
EOS.long_term_impact: Redundancy indexing layer; tapi dependency pada 2 external providers (EOS Rio, StreamingFast) — single points of failure jika salah satu down
EOS.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-022, EV-026; Phase 4 Core Components, Current Technical Stack; Phase 7 Infrastructure Providers, External Dependencies

EOS.title: Roadmap 2024-2025 mencakup horizontal scaling (sidechain), ZK integration, UX onboarding improvements
EOS.trigger: Tekanan kompetitif dari L2 Ethereum, Solana, modular blockchains (Celestia, Polygon CDK); throughput ceiling native (~4k TPS simple transfer)
EOS.evidence: ENF 6th anniversary roadmap publication; Leap 6.0 development branch (EV-029) mencakup experimental ZK-SNARK
EOS.decision: Public roadmap commit ke ZK, sidechains, better UX (sponsored tx, meta-tx native)
EOS.immediate_result: Visibilitas arah teknis ke komunitas/investor; Leap 6.0 development ongoing
EOS.long_term_impact: Jika delivered, EOS bisa kompetitif di modular/ZK era; tapi execution risk tinggi — tidak ada testnet/spec publik untuk ZK/IBC sidechains
EOS.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-027, EV-029; Phase 4 Known Technical Limitations, Technical Upgrade History; Phase 8 Narrative Position Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari "Block.one-centric" ke "Community-governed via ENF" · 2017-2021: Block.one sebagai sole funder, developer, decision maker; ICO proceeds ($4.1B) controlled by Block.one; Voice sebagai flagship app · 2021-sekarang: ENF formed (EV-017); 1% inflation redirected to ENF treasury; Block.one role reduced to IP holder/license holder; community BPs govern upgrades

(Phase 2 Entity Foundation, Phase 6 Governance) · TGE: HYPE staking live, governance "planned" tapi infrastructure (forum, proposal system, voting mechanism) tidak ada. Jito.title: Peluncuran Jito Restaking / Vault Node Consensus
Jito.trigger: Narasi restaking (EigenLayer) populer; Jito punya LST besar (JitoSOL) dan validator set; perlu ekonomi keamanan untuk layanan terdistribusi (oracle, bridge, keeper)
Jito.evidence: Jito Labs Blog "Introducing Jito Restaking" (Phase 3 EV-012); Audit Neodyme & Sec3 (Phase 3 EV-013); Phase 4 Core Components (Jito Restaking VNC)

Jito.immediate_result: TVL ~$300M awal 2025 (Phase 8 Adoption Metrics); NCN operator onboarding dimulai (Phase 7 Major Integrations)
Jito.long_term_impact: Memperluas utility JitoSOL beyond staking; menambah complexity & slashing risk (Phase 4 Known Technical Limitations); kompetisi langsung dengan Solayer (Phase 8 Competitor Landscape)
Jito.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-012, EV-013; Phase 4 Core Components, Known Technical Limitations, Audit History; Phase 7 Major Integrations; Phase 8 Adoption Metrics, Competitor Landscape Evolution Pattern Dari 2021–2024, Jito berevolusi melalui empat fase strategis: 1. **Infrastructure Build (2021–Agustus 2022)**: Fokus teknis murni — membangun Jito-Solana client, Block Engine, Relayer, ShredStream dari nol. Tidak ada token, tidak ada DAO, revenue hanya dari MEV tips ke validator. Pendanaan Series A $10M (EV-002) mempercepat hiring dan audit (Kudelski EV-007). Keputusan kunci: *centralized Block Engine operated by Jito Labs* untuk speed-to-market (Phase 4 Known Technical Limitations). 2. **Product Launch & Flywheel Creation (Agustus 2022–Desember 2022)**: Jito-Solana mainnet (EV-004) → JitoSOL launch (EV-005). Menciptakan loop: stake → JitoSOL → delegasi ke validator Jito → MEV tips → higher APY. Delegation permissioned memastikan validator menjalankan Jito-Solana (Phase 4 Core Components). Neodyme audit (EV-006) memberikan kepercayaan awal. 3. **Tokenization & Governance Transition (2023)**: Foundation formation (EV-008) → TGE JTO (EV-009) → DAO launch (EV-010). Shift dari company-controlled ke token-governed. Alokasi token: 71.5% insider (team 25%, investor 16.5%, foundation 30%) vs 10% community. Governance menggunakan SPL Governance standar (1 token = 1 vote) tanpa mekanisme anti-plutocracy. Sec3 audit governance (EV-011). 4. **Restaking & Horizontal Expansion (2024)**: Jito Restaking VNC (EV-012) menumpang pada JitoSOL & validator set. Audit ganda Neodyme+Sec3 (EV-013). Ekspansi DeFi integrasi berkelanjutan (EV-015). Strategi: *vertical integration* — MEV client → LST → Restaking → Governance — semua native Solana, tidak cross-chain. Pola evolusi: **Build infrastructure first, tokenize later, then expand vertically**. Setiap layer baru (MEV Suite → JitoSOL → JTO/DAO → Restaking) menumpang layer sebelumnya, menciptakan switching cost tinggi bagi validator dan staker. Technical Decision Pattern Pola 1: Fork Upstream Client (Agave/ANZA) + Minimal MEV Modifications · Decision Pattern: Jito-Solana mempertahankan kompatibilitas penuh dengan Solana upstream (Agave/ANZA) sambil menambahkan hanya modifikasi yang diperlukan untuk MEV: bundle processing, block engine integration, ShredStream support. Sinkronisasi rilis berkala mengikuti Agave.

Lido.title: Fee Switch Activation — 10% staking rewards ke treasury via LIP-22
Lido.trigger: Treasury butuh revenue sustainable untuk grants, core contributor budget, insurance; 5% fee (2020-2024) dianggap tidak cukup

Movement Labs.title: Mengembangkan MEVM (Move-EVM compatibility layer) sebagai fitur inti

Movement Labs.long_term_impact: Differentiator vs Move L1 (Aptos/Sui tidak EVM-compatible); trade-off: kompatibilitas tidak 100% (precompiles, opcode, gas semantics gaps)
Movement Labs.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-009, Phase 4 Execution Environment, Phase 7 Major Integrations (MEVM↔Hardhat/Foundry - Live), Phase 8 Competitor Landscape (vs Arbitrum/Optimism/Base EVM-equivalent)

Notcoin.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-013; Phase 8 Narrative Position, Competitor Landscape; Phase 4 Known Limitations (multi-chain not live) Evolution Pattern Phase 1: Game-Centric Off-Chain Viral Growth (Jan–Mar 2024) Fokus tunggal pada game tap-to-earn off-chain. Arsitektur: centralized game server + Telegram Mini App frontend. Tidak ada token on-chain. Growth mechanic: referral/squad viral loop. Metric utama: DAU, total users. Keputusan teknis: off-chain first untuk speed & UX, on-chain nanti. (EV-002, EV-003) Phase 2: Tokenization & Liquidity Event (Apr–May 2024) Transisi ke on-chain: snapshot saldo, mint Jetton NOT, TGE, CEX/DEX listing. Tokenomics 78/22 community-heavy. Distribusi instan tanpa vesting komunitas. Fokus: liquidity, price discovery, claim UX via wallet. (EV-004, EV-005) Phase 3: Platform Pivot — Discovery & Reward Layer (May–Jul 2024) Launch Explore (discovery) & Earn (reward campaigns). NOT utility: akses Earn, governance (Snapshot), LP, NFT. Partnership ekosistem TON (Tonstakers, bemo, Getgems). Revenue model: Earn fees + future ads. (EV-006, EV-007, EV-008, EV-009) Phase 4: Infrastructure Deepening — Account Abstraction Wallet (Oct 2024) Notcoin Smart Wallet (ERC-4337 AA) embedded di Mini App. Social recovery, gasless, fiat on-ramp. 2M+ deployments. Mengubah Notcoin dari app jadi wallet/infrastructure provider. Data layer untuk personalization. (EV-010) Phase 5: Platform Monetization & Scale (Nov 2024–Present) Telegram Ads revenue share pilot. Mini App Store featuring. 50M lifetime users. Roadmap v2: AI, multi-chain. Evolusi dari game → platform → infrastructure → AI-driven ecosystem. (EV-011, EV-012, EV-013) Pola evolusi konsisten: Setiap phase menambahkan layer baru di atas layer sebelumnya tanpa meninggalkan layer lama (game tetap accessible, token liquid, Explore/Earn aktif, Wallet live). Layer baru selalu leverage user base & data dari layer sebelumnya. Technical Decision Pattern Pola 1: Hybrid Off-Chain/On-Chain Architecture — Off-Chain untuk Throughput & UX, On-Chain untuk Settlement & Value · Decision Pattern: Game logic (tap counting, energy, boost, leaderboard) dijalankan off-chain di server terpusat; hanya settlement final (token claim, transfer, earn verification, wallet tx) di-on-chain-kan di TON

OlympusDAO.trigger: Visi founder (Zeus, War1, Juan) untuk reserve currency yang benar-benar terdesentralisasi dan community-owned sejak hari pertama
OlympusDAO.evidence: Blog launch menyatakan "fair launch, no pre-sale, no pre-mine" (HIGH) [https://blog.olympusdao.finance/launching-olympus-ohm-2021-03-20]
OlympusDAO.decision: Deploy kontrak OHM, bonding, staking langsung ke mainnet Ethereum; distribusi 100% via bonding dan staking terbuka
OlympusDAO.immediate_result: Token OHM beredar, treasury mulai mengakumulasi reserve assets via bonding, tidak ada investor eksternal yang memegang supply
OlympusDAO.long_term_impact: Menghindari tekanan jual early investor, menciptakan distribusi community-wide, namun memperlambat kapital awal vs VC-backed protocols
OlympusDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 1 Launch Date/TGE, Phase 3 EV-002, Phase 5 Funding History, Phase 6 TGE

OlympusDAO.title: Arsitektur modular V2 dengan stOHM dan gOHM
OlympusDAO.trigger: V1 monolithic contracts sulit di-upgrade, rebasing OHM tidak kompatibel DeFi, governance butuh non-rebasing token
OlympusDAO.evidence: Blog V2 announcement menjelaskan modularisasi bonding, staking, treasury, governance, policy; pengenalan stOHM (rebasing) dan gOHM (non-rebasing governance wrapper) (HIGH) [https://blog.olympusdao.finance/introducing-olympus-v2-3f5b5c5e5f5a]
OlympusDAO.decision: Migrasi ke kontrak modular terpisah dengan proxy upgradeability; stOHM untuk reward distribution, gOHM untuk governance/DeFi composability
OlympusDAO.immediate_result: Protokol lebih fleksibel, gOHM enable integrasi Aave/Curve/Balancer, stOHM handle rebasing secara terpisah
OlympusDAO.long_term_impact: Menjadi template dual-token model (rebasing + wrapped) yang diadopsi protokol lain; mempersiapkan fondasi untuk V3 kernel architecture
OlympusDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-003, EV-005, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Phase 6 Major Token Events

OlympusDAO.title: Launch Olympus Pro sebagai Bonding-as-a-Service
OlympusDAO.trigger: Permintaan protokol lain (Frax, Lido, dll) untuk mengakuisisi POL tanpa build bonding infrastructure sendiri; peluang revenue stream baru
OlympusDAO.evidence: Blog Olympus Pro partners mengumumkan 4 partner launch; docs menjelaskan Olympus Pro sebagai BaaS platform (HIGH) [https://blog.olympusdao.finance/olympus-pro-partners, https://docs.olympusdao.finance/main/products/olympus-pro]
OlympusDAO.decision: Build contract suite terpisah (olympus-pro-contracts) dengan factory pattern untuk partner bond markets; fee structure platform + deployment fee
OlympusDAO.immediate_result: Frax, Lido, Tokemak, Rari mulai menggunakan Olympus bonds untuk POL acquisition; revenue stream baru bagi Olympus treasury
OlympusDAO.long_term_impact: Memposisikan Olympus sebagai infrastructure layer untuk POL acquisition; menciptakan flywheel: more partners → more POL → stronger treasury → better OHM backing
OlympusDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-006, EV-009, Phase 4 Core Components Olympus Pro, Phase 5 Revenue Model, Phase 7 Major Integrations

OlympusDAO.title: Migration ke V3 Kernel Architecture
OlympusDAO.trigger: V2 modular tapi masih rigid; butuh policy-as-module, native multi-chain support, gas optimization, Olympus Pro integration yang lebih dalam
OlympusDAO.evidence: Blog V3 announcement menjelaskan kernel-based architecture, policy modules, deterministic deployment across chains (HIGH) [https://blog.olympusdao.finance/olympus-v3, https://docs.olympusdao.finance/main/contracts/v3]
OlympusDAO.decision: Rewrite penuh ke kernel-based modular architecture; Kernel coordinator manages module registration/authorization; Policy modules configurable per chain
OlympusDAO.immediate_result: Deployment deterministik ke Arbitrum dan Base dengan kontrak identik; gas optimization; policy flexibility
OlympusDAO.long_term_impact: Memungkinkan parallel deployment di EVM chains tanpa custom code per chain; namun treasury dan liquidity tetap terfragmentasi per chain (no unified cross-chain treasury)
OlympusDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-008, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Phase 4 System Architecture, Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks

OlympusDAO.title: Deployment ke Arbitrum (2022) dan Base
OlympusDAO.trigger: Ethereum L1 gas cost tinggi membatasi user adoption; Arbitrum menawarkan L2 scaling, Base memberikan akses ekosistem Coinbase/retail
OlympusDAO.evidence: Arbiscan/Basescan contract verification; docs networks page list 3 chain deployments (HIGH) [https://arbiscan.io/token/0x64aa, https://basescan.org/token/0x8662, https://docs.olympusdao.finance/main/networks]
OlympusDAO.decision: Full V3 deployment deterministik ke Arbitrum One (2022) dan Base Mainnet (2023)
OlympusDAO.immediate_result: OHM/stOHM/gOHM/bonding/staking tersedia di 3 chain dengan biaya gas jauh lebih rendah di L2
OlympusDAO.long_term_impact: Fragmentasi liquidity dan treasury per chain (isolated); no native cross-chain OHM transfer; user base expansion di Base via Coinbase ecosystem
OlympusDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-007, EV-010, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Phase 7 External Dependencies Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari Reserve Currency Tunggal → Infrastructure Layer (Olympus Pro) · Early phase (2021): Fokus ekslusif pada OHM sebagai reserve currency, bonding & staking untuk treasury growth sendiri · Pivot (2022): Olympus Pro meluaskan scope jadi BaaS provider; protokol lain menjadi customer, Olympus jadi infrastructure

Ethereum.title: Account abstraction native via EIP-7702 (Pectra) bersamaan ERC-4337 smart contract wallet
Ethereum.trigger: ERC-4337 live 2023 tapi butuh EntryPoint contract, bundler, paymaker — kompleksitas tinggi untuk EOA migration
Ethereum.evidence: EIP-7702 spec finalized di Pectra devnet (EV-029); AUTH/AUTHCALL opcode memungkinkan EOA delegate code sementara
Ethereum.decision: Dual path — ERC-4337 untuk smart contract wallet existing, EIP-7702 untuk upgrade EOA tanpa migrasi kontrak
Ethereum.immediate_result: Wallet (MetaMask, Coinbase, Safe) bisa implementasi AA native tanpa user deploy kontrak baru
Ethereum.long_term_impact: Menghilangkan perbedaan UX antara EOA dan smart account; gas sponsorship, session keys, social recovery jadi native
Ethereum.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-029, Phase 4 Execution Environment, Phase 7 Wallet Ecosystem

Ethereum.title: Publikasi Whitepaper Ethereum dan rekrutmen founding team
Ethereum.trigger: Vitalik Buterin mengusulkan platform turing-complete setelah kekurangan Bitcoin scripting
Ethereum.evidence: Whitepaper dipublikasikan via Bitcoin Magazine; 8 co-founder bergabung setelah presentasi Miami Jan 2014 (Phase 3 EV-001, EV-002)
Ethereum.decision: Menulis whitepaper, merekrut Gavin Wood (Yellow Paper), Jeffrey Wilcke (Geth), dan 5 co-founder lain untuk pendanaan/operasional
Ethereum.immediate_result: Tim founding 8 orang terbentuk; spesifikasi teknis (Yellow Paper EV-004) dan persiapan crowdsale dimulai
Ethereum.long_term_impact: Arsitektur EVM, multi-client development, dan model pendanaan publik menjadi fondasi seluruh ekosistem
Ethereum.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-001, EV-002, EV-004, Phase 2 Entities (Buterin, Wood, Wilcke, Hoskinson, Di Iorio, Alisie, Chetrit, Lubin)

Ethereum.title: Crowdsale publik ETH 42 hari tanpa VC/private sale
Ethereum.trigger: Butuh dana pengembangan; pilihan desain untuk distribusi fair dan hindari security law risk
Ethereum.evidence: 31.529 BTC terkumpul (~$18.3M); 60M ETH ke publik, 12M EH ke Foundation/early contributors (Phase 3 EV-005, EV-006; Phase 5 Token Sale)
Ethereum.decision: Penjualan terbuka harga 2000 ETH/BTC decay ke 1337 ETH/BTC; tanpa whitelist, tanpa lockup investor
Ethereum.immediate_result: Dana pengembangan terkumpul; distribusi genesis 72M ETH wide; tidak ada investor tradisional dengan hak preferensial
Ethereum.long_term_impact: Distribusi token paling merata di antara L1 besar; EF treasury menjadi dana utama protokol; tidak ada tekanan unlock VC
Ethereum.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-005, EV-006, Phase 5 Funding History, Token Sale, Phase 6 Distribution

Ethereum.title: Hard fork DAO untuk mengembalikan dana tercurig
Ethereum.trigger: The DAO exploit 3.6M ETH (EV-011); komunitas terpecah antara "code is law" vs intervensi sosial
Ethereum.evidence: Fork non-standar di blok 1.920.000; chain minoritas jadi Ethereum Classic (ETC) (Phase 3 EV-012)
Ethereum.decision: EF dan mayoritas client teams menerapkan irregular state change via hard fork
Ethereum.immediate_result: ~3.6M ETH dikembalikan ke withdrawal contract; lahirnya ETC sebagai chain terpisah
Ethereum.long_term_impact: Preseden governance off-chain social consensus; memvalidasi model EIP process + client adoption signaling; membedakan Ethereum dari "immutable at all costs"
Ethereum.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-011, EV-012, Phase 4 Governance Model, Phase 6 Governance

Ethereum.title: Transisi ke Proof-of-Stake via Beacon Chain parallel lalu Merge
Ethereum.trigger: Rencana sejak whitepaper; butuh desain aman untuk migrasi dari PoW tanpa downtime
Ethereum.evidence: Beacon Chain Phase 0 live 2020 (EV-020); Merge via TTD trigger di blok 15.537.393 (EV-026); emisi turun ~90%
Ethereum.decision: Arsitektur dual-layer (execution + consensus) terpisah dengan Engine API; validator deposit contract di mainnet; parallel run 1.5 tahun
Ethereum.immediate_result: PoS finalized; penambangan PoW berhenti; validator economics live; withdrawal enabled Shanghai 2023 (EV-027)
Ethereum.long_term_impact: Energy reduction >99%; deflationary mechanics via EIP-1559 burn + low issuance; staking yield as native DeFi primitive; institutional confidence (ETF approval 2024)
Ethereum.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-019, EV-020, EV-025, EV-026, EV-027, Phase 4 Consensus, Phase 6 Inflation/Deflation

Ethereum.title: Rollup-centric scaling roadmap dengan EIP-4844 proto-danksharding
Ethereum.trigger: L1 throughput ~15 TPS tidak cukup; L2 (Arbitrum, Optimism) sudah live tapi biaya data calldata tinggi
Ethereum.evidence: Vitalik 2020 blog "Rollup-Centric Roadmap"; Dencun aktivasi blob transactions (EV-028); L2 fees turun >90%; blob utilization ~8-17% (Phase 8 Adoption)
Ethereum.decision: Menambah blob gas market terpisah dari execution gas; KZG trusted setup ceremony 2023; 6 blob per slot target
Ethereum.immediate_result: L2 batch posting jauh lebih murah; Base, Arbitrum, Optimism throughput naik; data availability scaling dimulai
Ethereum.long_term_impact: Fondasi full Danksharding (PeerDAS, 16MB+/slot); modular data availability layer; L2 sebagai execution layer dominan
Ethereum.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-028, Phase 4 Architecture, Phase 7 L2 Integrations, Phase 8 Narrative Position

Ethereum.title: Spot ETH ETF approval US SEC dan trading
Ethereum.trigger: Tahun ber lobbying, litigasi Grayscale vs SEC untuk Bitcoin ETF preseden; Ethereum PoS + futures market matang
Ethereum.evidence: SEC approve 19b-4 untuk 9 issuer (BlackRock, Fidelity, Grayscale, Bitwise, VanEck, Ark, Invesco, Franklin, 21Shares); $1B+ day 1 volume (Phase 8 Market Timeline)
Ethereum.decision: EF dan industri tidak langsung mengontrol tapi menyediakan data transparansi (ultrasound.money, beaconcha.in); Coinbase Prime jadi custodian utama
Ethereum.immediate_result: Akses institusional regulasi ke ETH; AUM ETF tumbuh; staking yield tidak termasuk di ETF awal (hanya spot)
Ethereum.long_term_impact: Legitimasi aset kelas komoditas; aliran dana pensiun/endowment; tekanan regulasi staking-as-service (SEC vs Lido/Coinbase)
Ethereum.supporting_dataset: Phase 8 Market Timeline, Phase 5 Financial Risk, Phase 7 Infrastructure Providers Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari "World Computer" monolitik ke "Settlement Layer" modular untuk L2

Polymarket.title: Pendirian Polymarket Inc. dan protokol Polymarket
Polymarket.trigger: Identifikasi peluang pasar prediksi terdesentralisasi on-chain dengan UX yang lebih baik dari Augur v1
Polymarket.evidence: Blog peluncuran "Introducing Polymarket" Oktober 2020 menyebut visi founding (Phase 1 Foundation, Phase 3 EV-001)
Polymarket.decision: Mendirikan Delaware corporation, mengembangkan smart contract berbasis CTF Gnosis, CLOB proprietary, integrasi UMA Oracle
Polymarket.immediate_result: Entitas legal dan protokol terbentuk; pengembangan dimulai
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Menjadi fondasi seluruh ekosistem Polymarket hingga 2024
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 1 Foundation, Phase 2 Entity (Shayne Coplan, Polymarket Inc.), Phase 3 EV-001

Polymarket.title: Integrasi UMA Optimistic Oracle untuk resolusi pasar
Polymarket.trigger: Butuh mekanisme resolusi terdesentralisasi, trust-minimized untuk hasil pasar biner/kategorikal
Polymarket.evidence: Docs teknis menjelaskan UMA integration sebagai komponen kritis (Phase 3 EV-003, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Major Integrations)
Polymarket.decision: Mengadopsi UMA Optimistic Oracle (proposer/challenger + eskalasi tokenholder UMA)
Polymarket.immediate_result: Resolusi pasar berfungsi tanpa trusted central party
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Ketergantungan kritis pada UMA; risiko oracle menjadi single point of failure resolusi
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-003, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks

Polymarket.title: Mainnet Launch di Polygon
Polymarket.trigger: Kebutuhan execution environment murah dan cepat untuk high-frequency trading prediksi; Ethereum L1 gas terlalu mahal
Polymarket.evidence: Blog peluncuran menyebut Polygon sebagai chain utama (Phase 3 EV-002, Phase 4 System Architecture)
Polymarket.decision: Deploy kontrak inti, CLOB, UMA integration ke Polygon mainnet
Polymarket.immediate_result: Pasar prediksi live on-chain dengan USDC collateral; biaya transaksi rendah
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Polygon menjadi home chain utama 4+ tahun; likuiditas dan komunitas terkonsentrasi di sini
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-002, Phase 4 System Architecture, Phase 7 External Dependencies (Polygon)

Polymarket.title: Series A $4M dipimpin Polychain Capital
Polymarket.trigger: Perlu dana untuk ekspansi tim dan protokol pasca-mainnet
Polymarket.evidence: The Block melaporkan Series A (Phase 3 EV-004, Phase 5 Funding History)
Polymarket.decision: Menerima investasi Polychain Capital sebagai lead investor
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Memvalidasi protokol di mata investor crypto besar; fondasi untuk Series B

Polymarket.title: Penyelesaian CFTC $1.4M dan pembatasan pasar US
Polymarket.trigger: CFTC menuduh Polymarket menawarkan opsi biner tidak terdaftar
Polymarket.evidence: CFTC Press Release resmi, CoinDesk coverage (Phase 3 EV-005, Phase 5 Financial Risk)
Polymarket.decision: Bayar denda $1.4M, nonaktifkan pasar biner tertentu untuk IP AS, tingkatkan komitmen compliance
Polymarket.immediate_result: Akses pasar terbatas untuk pengguna AS; reputasi regulatory risk tercipta
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Membentuk strategi geo-fencing; narasi "non-US users primary" melekat; mempengaruhi tokenomics compliance
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-005, Phase 5 Financial Risk, Phase 8 Market Position

Polymarket.title: Series B $70M dipimpin Founders Fund (Peter Thiel)
Polymarket.trigger: Skala pasar membesar, perlu kapital signifikan untuk ekspansi global dan hiring
Polymarket.evidence: The Block, TechCrunch melaporkan Series B (Phase 3 EV-006, Phase 5 Funding History)
Polymarket.decision: Menerima $70M dari Founders Fund, ParaFi, Dragonfly
Polymarket.immediate_result: Valuasi melonjak; treasury besar untuk runway multi-tahun
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Investor high-profile (Thiel) menarik perhatian mainstream; tekanan untuk exit/token launch meningkat
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-006, Phase 5 Funding History, Phase 8 Market Timeline

Polymarket.title: Protocol V2 Upgrade
Polymarket.trigger: Butuh arsitektur lebih modular, gas efficiency, dukungan pasar kategorikal >2 outcome, UX better
Polymarket.evidence: GitHub commit history 2023, docs referensi v2 (Phase 3 EV-007, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History)
Polymarket.decision: Refactor kontrak (Exchange, Factory, Resolver modular), batch trade, permit signature, meta-tx
Polymarket.immediate_result: Gas lebih rendah, UX lebih baik, tipe pasar baru didukung
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Fondasi teknis untuk deployment Base dan scaling masa depan
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-007, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Phase 4 Development Framework

Polymarket.title: Deployment ke Base
Polymarket.trigger: Ekspansi multi-chain untuk akses ekosistem Coinbase, diversifikasi chain risk, likuiditas baru
Polymarket.evidence: Docs dan blog'announcement Base deployment (Phase 3 EV-008, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Phase 7 Major Integrations)
Polymarket.decision: Mirror kontrak dan CLOB ke Base mainnet; frontend chain switcher
Polymarket.immediate_result: Pasar tersedia di Base; bridging USDC didukung
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Multi-chain strategy live; parity fitur Base vs Polygon belum diverifikasi penuh
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-008, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 7 Open Threads

Polymarket.title: Peluncuran Points Program off-chain
Polymarket.trigger: Butuh insentif pengguna pre-TGE; membangun komunitas dan aktivitas trading/likuiditas
Polymarket.evidence: Blog pengumuman token menyebut points program sebagai basis airdrop (Phase 3 EV-009, Phase 6 Major Token Events)
Polymarket.decision: Off-chain points tracking (trading volume, liquidity, referrals), dashboard di frontend, snapshot berkala
Polymarket.immediate_result: >100k partisipan (estimasi blog "hundreds of thousands"); engagement naik
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Ekspektasi airdrop tercipta; liability tokenomics; regulatory risk pada points-as-securities
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-009, Phase 6 Token Information, Phase 6 Major Token Events, Phase 5 Financial Risk

Polymarket.title: Pengumuman Token POLYMARKET (Pre-TGE)
Polymarket.trigger: Pressure dari investor (Series B 2022), komunitas, dan narasi pre-TGE kompetitor (Blast, Linea, dll)
Polymarket.evidence: Blog resmi "Introducing the Polymarket Token" (Phase 3 EV-010, Phase 6 Token Information)
Polymarket.decision: Announce token rencana, nama POLYMARKET, utility governance + incentive; zero detail numerik (supply, allocation, vesting, TGE date)
Polymarket.immediate_result: Hype pasar, spekulasi komunitas, points program jadi "preskripsi"
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Tokenomics opacity menciptakan ketidakpastian; pressure untuk deliver TGE 2024/2025
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-010, Phase 6 Token Information, Phase 6 Distribution, Phase 6 Vesting Schedule

Polymarket.title: Record Volume saat Pemilu AS 2024
Polymarket.trigger: Siklus pemilu 4-tahunan mendorong minat global pada prediksi politik; media mainstream coverage
Polymarket.evidence: The Block, CoinDesk, Dune dashboard melaporkan volume >$500M bulanan (Phase 3 EV-012, Phase 8 Market Timeline, Phase 8 Narrative Position)
Polymarket.decision: Tidak ada keputusan aktif — pasar organik meledak; tim skalakan infra CLOB/indexer
Polymarket.immediate_result: Visibilitas mainstream puncak; "largest prediction market in crypto history" narasi
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Validasi product-market fit; tekanan untuk mempertahankan volume pasca-pemilu; investor menuntut monetisasi/token
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-012, Phase 8 Market Timeline, Phase 8 Narrative Position, Phase 8 Adoption Metrics Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari Single-Chain (Polygon) ke Multi-Chain (Polygon + Base)
